banner.title: gha-runner-scale-set-controller
banner.tagline: Runs the controller that turns GitHub job queues into runner pods, and alerts when they stall.

art.about: a controller that scales CI runner pods from a job queue
art.title: The runner controller and its alerts

explainer.title: One controller, one priority class, seven alerts

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Flux installs the controller chart and its CRDs into actions-runner-system with two replicas.
steps.scene: a sealed package unpacking into two cubes

steps.title: Reconcile
steps.text: The controller reconciles the runner scale sets declared by the two scale-set HelmReleases.
steps.scene: two gears meshing around a cyan ring

steps.title: Protect
steps.text: A PriorityClass ranks the controller and listeners above workloads, and a PDB keeps one replica up through drains.
steps.scene: a shield over two stacked towers

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: A PodMonitor scrapes controller and listener metrics every 15 seconds, and a Grafana dashboard reads them.
steps.scene: a rising signal line over a dashboard grid

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: Seven rules cover failure rate, idle runners, a down controller, slow startup, ghost jobs and listener restarts.
steps.scene: a bell with a small pulse of light
